leadText:
Bucky (Japanese: キイチ Kiichi) is a character of the day who appeared in The Dunsparce Deception.

He is a young boy who lives in Johto, in a small town between Ecruteak City and Olivine City. Bucky dreamed of a . However, he missed out on his chance to catch one when he was out of town, when a swarm of Dunsparce came through the area. All of his friends caught a Dunsparce during that time, Bucky ultimately being the only one who didn't get one.

When and heard about this, they decided to help Bucky out by searching for a Dunsparce. Eventually, one turned up. Bucky, using his , battled the Pokémon and successfully weakened it. He threw his and caught it, leaving him very happy.
